data.Q: Why does Jotham call the citizens of Shechem to listen?
data.A: So that God may listen to them.
data.wrong_answer: So that the trees can anoint a king.

data.Q: Who goes out to make a king for themselves?
Whom does Jotham address from Mount Gerizim?
To whom do the trees ask to rule them?
After Jotham hears about this, what does he do next?
data.A: He climbs Mount Gerizim and shouts to the citizens.
data.wrong_answer: The trees go to anoint a king.
